correctness.rationale: Facet contributions yield (2V/3) times the three-normal log-cosh sum. Each cosine obeys its cubic identity, and every even power sum has nonnegative coefficients in the square of the cubic angular parameter, with strict sixth-order dependence. This proves all-angle extrema for every scale. The unique John/Löwner circles follow from sixfold symmetry; a convex matrix-inverse variational argument proves their ratio is globally affine-optimal. Taylor expansions give 2/405 and the large-level 2/sqrt(3) limit. The standalone rational/numerical checks agree; smooth approximation uses weak surface-area-measure convergence and does not assume the polytope lies in the source smooth theorem.
